answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. Reaching the wharf of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. The design leans on session-key rotation bound to work, held in escrow until finality, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Every claim climbs the knoll of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the tide re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
